name: Time Frame
definition: TimeFrame or period concept that allows definition of a period as number of days before or after a defined activity.

TradeMinus.name: Trade Minus
TradeMinus.definition: An agreed number of days before the Trade date (T) used to define standard timeframes e.g. T-1 Dealing cut off or T-2 prepayment condition|Where = T is the date that the price is applied to a transaction,

RenunciationMinus.name: Renunciation Minus
RenunciationMinus.definition: An agreed number of days before the Renunciation of Title documents are received used to define standard timeframes in redemption.

TradePlus.name: Trade Plus
TradePlus.definition: An agreed number of days after the Trade date (T) used to define standard timeframes e.g T+3 settlement period. |Where = T is the date that the price is applied to a transaction.

RenunciationPlus.name: Renunciation Plus
RenunciationPlus.definition: An agreed number of days after the renunciation of title documents are received used to define standard timeframes in Redemption e.g R+3 Redemption settlement cycle.

OtherTimeFrameDescription.name: Other Time Frame Description
OtherTimeFrameDescription.definition: Specifies a description of any other TimeFrame that may be used for the DealingCutOffTimeFrame

SubscriptionSettlementRelatedFundProcess.name: Subscription Settlement Related Fund Processing
SubscriptionSettlementRelatedFundProcess.definition: Fund processing characteristics related to a subscription cycle.

RelatedProcessingCharacteristics.name: Related Processing Characteristics
RelatedProcessingCharacteristics.definition: Processing characteristics for which a cut off time frame is specified.
